cohort: The study included 176 Filipino pregnant women aged 15-49 years, recruited from 35 locations between October 2021 and December 2022.
finding: Overweight and obese women had nearly three times the odds of having a cesarean section, while those whose gestational weight gain was below the IOM recommendations had significantly lower odds of such a procedure.
mod_finding: Overweight and obese women were nearly three times more likely to have a cesarean section, while those with gestational weight gain below IOM recommendations had significantly lower odds of a cesarean section.
